basic_info.description: Step into style and comfort in this bright and airy 1-bedroom condo, where high ceilings create an incredible sense of space. Wake up to morning light and fresh air on your private walk-out balcony, directly off the bedroom  perfect for your coffee ritual or evening unwind.   The eat-in kitchen offers the ideal blend of function and charm, with room to cook, dine, and entertain, making it easy to enjoy everyday living or host guests. In addition to your private balcony, enjoy access to a shared yard  a rare urban retreat where you can relax, garden, or socialize. Dedicated storage and in unit laundry complete this unit's convenience.    Located less than a block from the vibrant Polk Street corridor, you'll have San Francisco's best shops, cafs, and restaurants right outside your door. Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizing, or looking for the perfect pied--terre, this condo offers modern comfort in an unbeatable location.
